title: Activity Data Contract
description: Defines the schema for the gold 'Activity' entity, aligned with RULES.md §7.1. This contract is for data consumers.

activity_id.description: Unique identifier for the activity record.

molecule_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL ID of the tested molecule.

target_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL ID of the biological target.

standard_value.description: The standardized value of the measurement.

standard_units.description: The standardized units of the measurement (e.g., 'nM').

pchembl_value.description: The pChEMBL value (-log10 of the molar activity).

data_validity_comment.description: Comment on the validity of the data point.

action_type_action_type.description: Type of action (e.g., INHIBITOR, AGONIST, ANTAGONIST).

_source_batch_id.description: Internal ID linking to the source Bronze batch for lineage.

_content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the record's content for versioning and deduplication.

_ingestion_ts.description: UTC timestamp of when the record was ingested.
